title: MARBLE: A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking spatial reasoning and planning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) through two specific tasks: M-Portal (based on the game Portal 2) and M-Cube (3D jigsaw puzzles). It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
